name: Academic Stress Disorder
what_it_is: A state of acute or chronic psychological distress stemming from intense educational pressure, fear of academic failure, and excessive workload.
what_it_does: Triggers persistent anxiety, mental burnout, procrastination, physical tension (headaches, stomachaches), and impaired cognitive function during school or university evaluation periods.

name: Acute Stress Disorder (ASD)
what_it_is: A transient mental health condition occurring within 1 month following exposure to a severe traumatic or life-threatening event.
what_it_does: Causes acute trauma responses including intrusive flashbacks, emotional numbness, severe anxiety, hypervigilance, and sleep disturbances lasting between 3 days and 4 weeks.

name: ADHD (Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder)
what_it_is: A neurodevelopmental condition characterized by persistent patterns of inattention, hyperactivity, and executive function dysregulation.
what_it_does: Alters brain dopamine signaling, causing difficulty sustaining focus, disorganization, time blindness, emotional dysregulation, and motor restlessness.
slang: Hyper, Scatter-brain, Glitch-brain, Bouncing off walls

name: Agoraphobia
what_it_is: An anxiety disorder involving intense fear of being in places or situations where escape might be difficult or help unavailable during panic episodes.
what_it_does: Causes severe avoidance of open spaces, crowds, public transit, or leaving the home alone, frequently leading to profound social isolation.

name: Alcohol & Spirits
what_it_is: A psychoactive central nervous system depressant produced through the fermentation of sugars (found in beer, wine, and spirits).
what_it_does: Enhances GABA neurotransmitter activity to slow central nervous system function, initially causing euphoria and lowered inhibitions, followed by impaired motor control, mood swings, liver strain, and chemical dependency.
slang: Booze, Sauce, Juice, Musombodia, Kachasu, Chibuku, Scud, Soldier, Dop, Tavern-water

name: Algorithmic Rage-Bait
what_it_is: Digital content engineered specifically to evoke moral outrage or anger, prioritized by social media algorithms to maximize user retention.
what_it_does: Traps users in dopamine-driven stress loops, reinforces black-and-white thinking, elevates baseline cortisol, and induces compulsive doomscrolling.

name: Anabolic Steroids
what_it_is: Synthetic variations of the male sex hormone testosterone used non-medically to accelerate muscle growth and physical performance.
what_it_does: Promotes muscle tissue synthesis while shutting down natural testosterone production; causes severe mood volatility ("roid rage"), cardiovascular damage, severe acne, and hormonal imbalances.

name: Anorexia Nervosa
what_it_is: A serious eating disorder characterized by abnormally low body weight, intense fear of gaining weight, and a distorted perception of body shape.
what_it_does: Drives severe caloric restriction, compulsive exercising, rapid weight loss, low blood pressure, electrolyte imbalance, hypothermia, and high risk of organ failure.

name: Antisocial Personality Disorder (ASPD)
what_it_is: A personality disorder characterized by a persistent pattern of disregard for, and violation of, the rights and feelings of others.
what_it_does: Leads to deceitfulness, impulsivity, physical aggressiveness, lack of remorse, disregard for safety, and repeated legal or social conflicts.

name: ARFID (Avoidant/Restrictive Food Intake Disorder)
what_it_is: An eating disorder involving extreme food restriction or avoidance based on sensory characteristics (texture, smell) or fear of negative consequences (choking, vomiting), without body image distress.
what_it_does: Results in severe nutritional deficiencies, unnatural weight loss or stunted growth, and acute distress during shared meals.

name: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)
what_it_is: A neurodevelopmental condition characterized by variations in social communication, sensory processing, and repetitive patterns of behavior or focused interests.
what_it_does: Shapes how individuals process sensory input and navigate social cues, often causing sensory overload in noisy environments, deep topic hyper-focus, and a preference for predictable routines.

name: Avoidant Personality Disorder (AVPD)
what_it_is: A personality disorder characterized by pervasive social inhibition, intense feelings of inadequacy, and extreme hypersensitivity to negative evaluation.
what_it_does: Forces complete avoidance of social or occupational activities that involve interpersonal contact due to intense fears of rejection, shame, or embarrassment.

name: Betel Nut
what_it_is: The seed of the *Areca catechu* palm, chewed socially across parts of Asia and Africa as a natural psychoactive stimulant.
what_it_does: Releases arecoline to increase alertness and heart rate; chronic use causes bright red staining of saliva, oral submucous fibrosis, and heightened risk of oral cancers.

name: Binge Eating Disorder (BED)
what_it_is: An eating disorder marked by recurrent episodes of consuming large quantities of food rapidly and uncontrollably, accompanied by emotional distress but without purging.
what_it_does: Causes loss of control during eating episodes, profound emotional guilt and shame, physical abdominal pain, metabolic strain, and long-term risks of depression and obesity.

name: Bipolar Disorder
what_it_is: A mood disorder characterized by extreme shifts in energy, mood, and activity levels, alternating between manic (highs) and depressive (lows) episodes.
what_it_does: Manic states trigger inflated grandiosity, decreased need for sleep, and risky impulsivity; depressive states bring severe fatigue, hopelessness, and loss of functioning.

name: Body Dysmorphic Disorder (BDD)
what_it_is: An obsessive-compulsive related disorder involving obsessive preoccupation with perceived defects or flaws in physical appearance that are unnoticeable or minor to others.
what_it_does: Drives time-consuming compulsions like constant mirror checking, excessive grooming, skin picking, or seeking unnecessary cosmetic procedures to fix the perceived flaw.

name: Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD)
what_it_is: A personality disorder characterized by severe emotional instability, unstable interpersonal relationships, distorted self-image, and intense impulsivity.
what_it_does: Triggers extreme fears of abandonment, rapid mood swings lasting hours to days, intense identity confusion, emotional reactivity, and chronic self-harm risks.

name: Brief Psychotic Disorder
what_it_is: A sudden, short-term onset of psychotic symptoms (delusions, hallucinations, disorganized speech) lasting between 1 day and 1 month, followed by full recovery.
what_it_does: Disrupts reality testing following extreme trauma or stress, causing sudden disorientation, intense fear, and temporary inability to care for oneself.

name: Bulimia Nervosa
what_it_is: An eating disorder characterized by cycles of binge eating followed by compensatory behaviors ("purging") such as self-induced vomiting or laxative abuse.
what_it_does: Induces rapid electrolyte imbalance, severe acid erosion of tooth enamel, swollen salivary glands, gastrointestinal damage, and intense emotional guilt.

name: Cannabis / Mbanje / Skunk
what_it_is: A psychoactive plant containing delta-9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) and cannabidiol (CBD), ingested via smoking, vaping, or edibles.
what_it_does: Alters sensory perception, mood, and appetite; frequent high-THC exposure can impair short-term memory, lower motivation, elevate anxiety, and trigger psychotic symptoms in vulnerable users.
slang: Mbanje, Dagga, Zol, Ganja, Ndombo, Kush, Zaza, Weed, Pot, Mary Jane, Herb, Bud, Loud, Grass

name: Club Drugs (Ecstasy / MDMA, GHB)
what_it_is: Synthetic psychoactive substances used primarily in nightlife and festival settings to alter consciousness and sensory perception.
what_it_does: Floods brain serotonin and dopamine receptors, producing temporary euphoria and sensory enhancement; risks include dangerous body overheating, sudden dehydration, memory loss, and severe mid-week emotional crashes.
slang: E, X, Molly, Mandy, Love-drug, G, Liquid-E, Rave-fuel

name: Cocaine & Crack Cocaine
what_it_is: A powerful, highly addictive central nervous system stimulant derived from coca leaves (powder cocaine) or processed into a smokeable freebase (crack).
what_it_does: Blocks dopamine reuptake, producing a short-lived surge of intense euphoria and confidence, followed by severe anxiety, violent paranoia, elevated heart rate, and cardiovascular collapse risk.
slang: Coke, Snow, Blow, White, Yayo, Charlie, Rock, Crack, Freebase

name: Codeine / Prescription Cough Syrups
what_it_is: An opioid analgesic and cough suppressant present in prescription syrups and pain medications (misused as "Lean" or "Bronco").
what_it_does: Binds to mu-opioid receptors to suppress pain and central coughing reflexes, inducing sedation and euphoria; high doses cause severe respiratory depression, constipation, and physical addiction.
slang: Lean, Purple Drank, Sizzurp, Bronco, Tosein, Chigubhu, Supa, Benylin, Sip, Dirty Sprite

name: Complex PTSD (C-PTSD)
what_it_is: A severe trauma condition resulting from long-term, repeated interpersonal trauma (such as severe childhood abuse or captivity) from which escape was impossible.
what_it_does: Causes core disruptions in emotional self-regulation, persistent feelings of toxic shame and worthlessness, profound difficulties forming safe relationships, and severe chronic hypervigilance.

name: Crystal Methamphetamine
what_it_is: A potent, illicit synthetic central nervous system stimulant appearing as clear crystal rocks ("Tik", "Meth").
what_it_does: Releases massive surges of dopamine, granting intense euphoria and suppression of fatigue; prolonged bingeing causes sleep loss, skin-picking, severe dental decay ("meth mouth"), violent paranoia, and drug-induced psychosis.
slang: Tik, Meth, Ice, Glass, Tina, Crank, Speed, Shards, Mutoriro, Dombo, Guka, Chandagwinya, Bole, Harare Water

name: Cultural / Spiritual Distress
what_it_is: Psychological anguish experienced when an individual's personal choices, mental health, or lifestyle conflict severely with their cultural, religious, or community identity.
what_it_does: Induces deep internal shame, fear of spiritual punishment, ostracization from family networks, and severe emotional isolation.

name: Dating & Hookup Apps
what_it_is: Geolocation-based digital platforms engineered for rapid social, romantic, or sexual matching through swipe mechanics.
what_it_does: Utilizes variable dopamine reward schedules via matches and messages; over-reliance can foster validation dependence, high rejection sensitivity, commodification of social interaction, and persistent low self-worth.

name: Delayed Sleep Phase Disorder
what_it_is: A circadian rhythm sleep disorder where an individual's internal sleep clock is delayed by two or more hours relative to standard social schedules.
what_it_does: Prevents falling asleep before late hours (e.g., 2:00 AM–4:00 AM), resulting in acute morning exhaustion, daytime fatigue, and chronic performance impairment at school or work.

name: Depersonalization / Derealization Disorder
what_it_is: A dissociative disorder where individuals repeatedly feel detached from their own physical body (depersonalization) or feel that their surrounding environment is dreamlike or fake (derealization).
what_it_does: Creates a troubling sensation of viewing oneself from outside the body, emotional numbness, altered perception of space or time, and intense distress.

name: Dissociative Anesthetics & Sedatives (Benzodiazepines)
what_it_is: Prescription central nervous system depressants (e.g., Valium, Xanax) and anesthetic compounds misused for calm, intoxication, or escape.
what_it_does: Enhances inhibitory GABA neurotransmitters to slow neural speed; induces muscle relaxation, drowsiness, and amnesia; combining with alcohol carries high fatal overdose risks.
slang: Benzos, Xannies, Valium, Roofies, Barbs, Tranks, Downers, Ludes, Mandrax, Buttons, Whites, MX

name: Dissociative Identity Disorder (DID)
what_it_is: A complex dissociative condition characterized by the presence of two or more distinct personality states ("alters") that alternately control behavior, usually rooted in severe early trauma.
what_it_does: Causes significant memory gaps for everyday events, personal identity details, and trauma history, accompanied by distinct internal identity shifts.

name: Energy Drinks & High-Caffeine Products
what_it_is: Commercial beverages containing high concentrations of caffeine, taurine, and sugar designed to rapidly elevate central nervous system alertness.
what_it_does: Blocks adenosine receptors in the brain to prevent fatigue signaling; excessive consumption induces cardiac racing, elevated blood pressure, hand tremors, acute panic attacks, and severe insomnia.
slang: Buzz-in-a-can, Jitter juice, Liquid Speed, Heart-starter, Monster, Red Bull, Booster

name: Excoriation Disorder (Skin Picking)
what_it_is: An obsessive-compulsive related condition characterized by recurrent, compulsive picking at one's own skin, resulting in physical lesions.
what_it_does: Acts as an involuntary physical coping response to stress or internal anxiety; leads to open sores, tissue infection risk, permanent scarring, and severe social embarrassment.

name: Forex & Crypto Trading Conditioning
what_it_is: A behavioral addiction driven by volatile financial markets, high-leverage trading applications, and constant digital market updates disguised as routine investing.
what_it_does: Triggers high dopamine volatility through rapid financial wins and losses, driving chart obsession, loss-chasing, severe debt, and chronic anxiety.
slang: Ponzi-scheme, QFX, Hustle, Moon-shot, Crypto-bro, Rug-pull, FX-flex

name: Gambling & Sports Betting
what_it_is: Wagering money or valuables on unpredictable outcomes, increasingly gamified through digital betting applications and mobile casinos.
what_it_does: Hijacks natural reward pathways through intermittent payouts; leads to compulsive loss-chasing, secret borrowing, catastrophic personal debt, and severe depression.
slang: Mabhetis, Aviator, Slot, Fafi, Machaena, Hollywoodbets, Spina Zonke, The House, Ticket-burner, Bookie-bleed, Parlay-trap

name: Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD)
what_it_is: An anxiety disorder characterized by persistent, excessive, and uncontrollable worry about everyday events for at least 6 months.
what_it_does: Keeps the sympathetic nervous system on high alert, causing chronic muscle tension, physical fatigue, irritability, difficulty concentrating, and restless sleep.

name: Grief and Bereavement
what_it_is: The deep emotional, psychological, and physical reaction experienced following the death of a loved one or profound loss.
what_it_does: Causes waves of intense sadness, cognitive shock, numbness, appetite disruption, physical fatigue, and difficulty engaging in normal routines.

name: Hallucinogens
what_it_is: A broad group of psychoactive substances (e.g., PCP, Ketamine) that cause deep distortions in sensory perception and spatial awareness.
what_it_does: Alters serotonin and glutamate pathways; causes visual distortions, detachment from physical environment, elevated blood pressure, erratic behaviors, and prolonged psychological distress.
slang: Trips, Dissociatives, K, Special K, Angel-dust

name: Heroin & Street Opiates / Nyaope
what_it_is: An illegal, highly addictive semi-synthetic opioid processed from morphine, or crude street mixtures (Nyaope/Whoonga) mixed with dangerous adulterants.
what_it_does: Binds immediately to central mu-opioid receptors, producing intense physical numbness and euphoria; high doses suppress involuntary breathing, presenting severe fatal overdose and physical dependency risks.
slang: Smack, H, Horse, Brown Sugar, Black Tar, Junk, Dope, Unga, Muteyo, Hero, Nyaope, Whoonga, Sugba, Pinch, Plazma

name: Hoarding Disorder
what_it_is: An obsessive-compulsive related condition involving persistent difficulty discarding or parting with possessions, regardless of their actual monetary value.
what_it_does: Causes excessive accumulation of physical clutter, rendering living areas unusable, creating fire hazards, and straining family relationships.

name: Hypersomnia
what_it_is: A sleep disorder characterized by excessive daytime sleepiness or abnormally long nighttime sleep duration without feeling rested.
what_it_does: Causes involuntary daytime sleep episodes, cognitive sluggishness ("brain fog"), low daily energy, and difficulties maintaining academic or job commitments.

name: Impulse E-Commerce
what_it_is: Compulsive online shopping enabled by algorithmic promotions, flash sales, and instant digital checkouts.
what_it_does: Provides a short-lived dopamine spike upon purchasing, followed by buyer's remorse, unmanageable clutter, credit card debt, and hidden spending habits.

name: Inhalants & Industrial Solvents
what_it_is: Chemical vapors inhaled through the nose or mouth to produce rapid mind-altering intoxication (e.g., glues, petrol, aerosol sprays).
what_it_does: Depresses central nervous system function rapidly; causes dizziness, slurred speech, irreversible brain damage, liver failure, and sudden fatal cardiac arrhythmia.
slang: Glue, Petrol, Thinner, Genkem, Bostik, Pata Pata, Whippets, Poppers, Rush, Snappers, Laughing gas, Air blast

name: Insomnia Disorder
what_it_is: A sleep-wake disorder characterized by persistent difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or waking too early despite adequate opportunity for rest.
what_it_does: Severely degrades daytime energy, emotional regulation, memory consolidation, immune function, and overall cognitive speed.

name: Intellectual Disability
what_it_is: A neurodevelopmental condition originating during development, characterized by significant limitations in intellectual functioning and adaptive behavior.
what_it_does: Affects learning speed, complex problem-solving, abstract reasoning, and daily practical living skills, requiring tailored social and educational support.

name: Khat / Mairungi
what_it_is: Leaves and shoots of the *Catha edulis* plant, chewed as a traditional stimulant in parts of East Africa and the Middle East.
what_it_does: Releases cathinone to stimulate the central nervous system, increasing energy and alertness while suppressing appetite; chronic use causes mouth ulcers, high blood pressure, and sleep disruption.
slang: Mairungi, Kat, Qat, Miraa, African Salad, Bushman's Tea, Tschat, Chat, Abyssinian Tea, Oat

name: Kratom
what_it_is: A Southeast Asian tropical tree (*Mitragyna speciosa*) whose leaves contain compounds that act as stimulants at low doses and opioids at high doses.
what_it_does: Binds to brain opioid receptors; relieves pain or increases energy depending on dose, but carries risks of physical dependency, liver distress, and withdrawal symptoms.

name: Learning Disorders (Dyslexia, Dyscalculia)
what_it_is: Neurodevelopmental conditions that specifically impair an individual's ability to process, comprehend, or retain written words (dyslexia) or numerical math concepts (dyscalculia).
what_it_does: Disrupts standard academic performance in reading or math despite average or above-average intelligence, causing emotional frustration and low self-confidence if unaccommodated.

name: Major Depressive Disorder (MDD)
what_it_is: A primary mood disorder characterized by persistent feelings of sadness, emptiness, and complete loss of interest in activities (anhedonia) for at least two weeks.
what_it_does: Alters neural circuitry, inducing severe physical fatigue, weight/appetite shifts, disrupted sleep, overwhelming feelings of worthlessness, slowed thinking, and suicidal thoughts.
slang: Depression, The Blues, Black Dog, Dark-hole, Funk

name: Music as Conditioning
what_it_is: The psychological conditioning effect of repetitive musical media and subcultures that glorify substance abuse, crime, or harmful behaviors.
what_it_does: Desensitizes listeners to risky behaviors through continuous repetition, shaping peer norms, self-identity, and substance expectations.

name: Narcissistic Personality Disorder (NPD)
what_it_is: A personality disorder characterized by a pervasive pattern of grandiosity, a continuous need for admiration, and a lack of empathy for others.
what_it_does: Drives manipulative social behavior, extreme entitlement, fragile self-esteem, intense sensitivity to perceived criticism, and explosive anger when challenged.

name: Nitrous Oxide
what_it_is: A gas ("laughing gas", "whippets") used as an anesthetic or commercial canister propellant, inhaled illicitly for rapid, short-lived intoxication.
what_it_does: Displaces oxygen in the lungs to produce brief lightheadedness and giggling; chronic inhalation inactivates Vitamin B12, causing severe nerve damage, numbness, and mobility impairment.
slang: Laughing gas, Whippets, NOS, Nitro, Balloons

name: Non-Suicidal Self-Injury (NSSI)
what_it_is: Deliberate, direct destruction of body tissue (e.g., cutting, burning) performed without suicidal intent.
what_it_does: Used as an unhealthy attempt to release unmanageable emotional pain, numbness, or internal anger; risks physical tissue damage, permanent scarring, severe infections, and accidental medical emergencies.

name: Online Gaming Conditioning
what_it_is: Compulsive engagement with video games engineered with predatory retention mechanics like loot boxes, daily reward streaks, and pay-to-progress systems.
what_it_does: Triggers dopamine releases through artificial achievement metrics; leads to neglected school/work duties, sleep deprivation, explosive frustration, and unwanted financial spending.

name: Orthorexia
what_it_is: An unhealthy obsession with eating only foods deemed hyper-clean, pure, or naturally correct, accompanied by rigid dietary restrictions.
what_it_does: Transforms eating into strict moral rules; induces severe anxiety over minor food rule breaks, causing malnutrition and severe social meal avoidance.

name: OTCs & Lifestyle Supplements Abuse
what_it_is: The improper, excessive, or non-label misuse of over-the-counter medications (painkillers, decongestants) or fitness/weight-loss supplements.
what_it_does: Causes toxicity strain on the liver and kidneys, rebound physical headaches, digestive distress, and psychological reliance.
slang: Mapills, Wellness-poppers, Gym-sauce, Pep-pills, Over-the-counter high

name: Panic Disorder
what_it_is: An anxiety disorder characterized by recurrent, unexpected panic attacks—sudden surges of extreme fear and physical distress reaching a peak within minutes.
what_it_does: Activates intense physical terror symptoms (chest tightness, racing heart, dizziness, feeling of choking) and persistent anticipatory fear of the next attack.

name: Persistent Depressive Disorder (Dysthymia)
what_it_is: A continuous, chronic form of depression lasting for two years or longer, characterized by mild-to-moderate low mood.
what_it_does: Creates a long-term baseline of low energy, gloomy outlook, poor self-worth, and low daily motivation.

name: Petrol Sniffing
what_it_is: The direct inhalation of gasoline fumes to produce rapid psychoactive intoxication.
what_it_does: Concentrates highly toxic hydrocarbons in the brain; causes rapid intoxication, severe neurological damage, memory loss, seizures, and organ failure.

name: Phobias
what_it_is: Intense, irrational, and persistent fears of specific objects, animals, or situations (e.g., heights, spiders, injections) that pose little real danger.
what_it_does: Triggers immediate physical panic reactions upon exposure, forcing extreme behavioral avoidance of the stimulus.

name: Pornography Conditioning
what_it_is: Compulsive consumption of high-novelty digital adult content enabled by smartphones and high-speed internet.
what_it_does: Desensitizes brain reward pathways to natural physical intimacy, alters sexual expectations, and can cause sexual dysfunction, relationship dissatisfaction, and guilt.
slang: P-hub, Adult-sites, Smut, Goon-material, Corn, Korn, NSFW

name: Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)
what_it_is: A psychiatric disorder triggered by experiencing or witnessing a terrifying or life-threatening traumatic event.
what_it_does: Traps the nervous system in a state of high threat; causes intrusive traumatic flashbacks, nightmares, hypervigilance, and emotional avoidance of trauma triggers.

name: Prescription Stimulants Abuse
what_it_is: Non-medical misuse or unprescribed overuse of prescription ADHD medications (e.g., Adderall, Ritalin).
what_it_does: Rapidly elevates dopamine and norepinephrine to boost alertness; causes loss of appetite, insomnia, rapid heart rate, severe rebound anxiety, and physical dependency.

name: Psychedelics
what_it_is: A class of hallucinogenic compounds (e.g., psilocybin mushrooms, LSD) that primarily affect serotonin 5-HT2A brain receptors.
what_it_does: Induces vivid visual changes, altered self-perception, and temporal distortion; carries risks of triggering intense psychological panic ("bad trips") or underlying psychotic vulnerabilities.
slang: Shrooms, Mushies, Magic Mushrooms, Acid, Lucy, Dots, Microdots, Trips, Alice

name: Radio Conditioning
what_it_is: Repeated exposure to broadcast radio commercial jingles and announcements promoting alcohol, gambling, or commercial products.
what_it_does: Fosters sub-conscious environmental conditioning, establishing auditory cues that evoke immediate product cravings or behavioral triggers.

name: Schizoaffective Disorder
what_it_is: A complex mental health disorder featuring a combination of schizophrenia symptoms (hallucinations, delusions) alongside mood disorder episodes (mania or depression).
what_it_does: Creates overlapping cycles of severe mood swings and loss of touch with reality, severely disrupting social, emotional, and independent functioning.

name: Schizophrenia
what_it_is: A severe chronic mental disorder characterized by deep disruptions in thought processes, perceptions, emotional responsiveness, and reality testing.
what_it_does: Causes positive symptoms (auditory/visual hallucinations, delusions, disorganized speech) and negative symptoms (flat emotional expression, social withdrawal, loss of goal-directed motivation).
slang: Kupenga, Kutsva musoro, Chiteshi, Ingutsheni-bound, Seeing ghosts, Tripping, Losing it, Psycho, Brain-glitch

name: Seasonal Affective Disorder (SAD)
what_it_is: A subtype of major depression that recurs predictably during specific seasons—most commonly winter when sunlight hours are shortest.
what_it_does: Disrupts natural circadian melatonin and serotonin regulation; leads to low winter energy, carbohydrate cravings, oversleeping, and seasonal depression.

name: Social Anxiety Disorder
what_it_is: An anxiety disorder characterized by severe fear and discomfort in social or performance situations where one might be scrutinized or judged.
what_it_does: Produces physical anxiety symptoms (blushing, sweating, shaking, nausea) when around others, leading to persistent social avoidance and isolation.

name: Social Media Conditioning
what_it_is: Compulsive engagement with social media platforms engineered with algorithmic feeds, instant notifications, and social validation mechanics.
what_it_does: Rewires attention spans, generates FOMO (Fear Of Missing Out), encourages harmful social comparisons, disrupts sleep schedules, and elevates baseline anxiety.
slang: The Gram, Tok, Bird-app, Clock-app, Scroll-hole, Dopamine-feed, Doom-scroll

name: Somatic Symptom Disorder
what_it_is: A mental disorder characterized by an intense, disproportionate focus and anxiety regarding physical symptoms (such as pain or fatigue).
what_it_does: Causes intense health anxiety, frequent medical consultations without physical diagnosis, and severe disruption to daily activities.

name: Substance-Induced Mood Disorder
what_it_is: A significant disruption in mood (depressive or manic) directly caused by drug intoxication, chemical toxicity, or withdrawal.
what_it_does: Temporarily or permanently alters brain chemistry, triggering intense emotional crashes, volatility, or manic surges linked to chemical use.

name: Substance-Induced Psychosis
what_it_is: The sudden onset of acute psychotic symptoms (hallucinations, paranoia, severe delusions) caused directly by drug intoxication or chemical toxicity.
what_it_does: Severely distorts reality during or immediately following drug intake, leading to erratic, terrified, or dangerous behavior.

name: Suicidal Ideation
what_it_is: Thoughts, considerations, or preoccupations with ending one's own life, ranging from passive wishes to detailed explicit planning.
what_it_does: Acts as a vital indicator of unbearable emotional pain, despair, or psychiatric distress; requires immediate compassionate crisis intervention and care.

name: Suicide Attempt
what_it_is: A non-fatal, self-directed act undertaken with the explicit intent to end one's life.
what_it_does: Represents an acute psychiatric and medical emergency requiring immediate hospitalization, safety planning, and intensive clinical trauma support.

name: Synthetic Cannabinoids (K2 / Spice)
what_it_is: Laboratory-synthesized chemicals sprayed onto plant material designed to bind to cannabinoid brain receptors.
what_it_does: Binds with full agonist potency to cannabinoid receptors; causes unpredictable severe toxicity, rapid heart rate, violent agitation, vomiting, seizures, and acute psychosis.

name: Television Conditioning
what_it_is: Passive, prolonged consumption of television broadcasting, reality content, or continuous commercial advertising.
what_it_does: Promotes sedentary habits, continuous exposure to subtle lifestyle advertising, altered perceptions of realistic social behavior, and bedtime procrastination.

name: Tobacco & Shisha
what_it_is: Nicotine-dense leaves prepared for smoking in cigarettes, cigars, or hookah (shisha), or chewed.
what_it_does: Delivers nicotine to brain nicotinic receptors, creating brief physical calm followed by high nicotine dependency, cardiovascular stress, severe respiratory damage, and cancer risks.
slang: Fags, Smokes, Butts, Dip, Chew, Chaw, Bute, Chimonera, Fodya, Loose stick, Gwai, Zol, Entlek, Snuff, Hookah, Hubbly Bubbly

name: Trichotillomania (Hair Pulling)
what_it_is: An obsessive-compulsive related condition involving recurrent, irresistible urges to pull out hair from one's scalp, eyebrows, or body.
what_it_does: Functions as an involuntary physical release for internal tension or stress, resulting in visible hair loss, skin damage, emotional distress, and social embarrassment.

name: Ultra-Processed Foods & Sugar
what_it_is: Industrially manufactured food products high in refined sugars, unhealthy fats, and additives designed to maximize sensory palatability.
what_it_does: Rapidly spikes blood glucose and dopamine reward pathways; drives compulsive overeating cycles, metabolic fatigue, rapid energy crashes, and long-term diabetes risks.

name: Unemployment Depression
what_it_is: A situational depressive response stemming from sustained joblessness, financial uncertainty, and loss of professional routine or purpose.
what_it_does: Induces feelings of worthlessness, daily apathy, chronic financial panic, social withdrawal, and reduced confidence during job search efforts.

name: Vaping & E-Cigarettes
what_it_is: Battery-powered devices that vaporize liquid nicotine formulations, flavorings, and chemicals for inhalation.
what_it_does: Delivers high concentrations of nicotine salts rapidly into the pulmonary system, establishing chemical addiction, airway inflammation, persistent coughing, and lung toxicity risks.
slang: Vape, Juul, Puffbar, Clouds, Nic-stick, Smoke-pen, Vapor-stick
